texts.content: {"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 127], "size": 5, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": []}], "text": "Host: Hey there! Today we’re tackling a question that has been debated by food enthusiasts everywhere: is a hot dog a sandwich?"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 33], "size": 5, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": []}], "text": "Guest: Absolutely! Let’s dive in!"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 64], "size": 5, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": []}], "text": "Host: Now, the argument is that both contain meat between bread."}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 84], "size": 5, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": []}], "text": "Guest: True, but sandwiches are typically served open-faced. Hot dogs have a casing!"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 71], "size": 5, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": []}], "text": "Host: Okay, but what about the bun? Is it enough to make it a sandwich?"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 115], "size": 5, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": []}], "text": "Guest: In sandwiches, the bread usually touches the top and bottom of the meat. Hot dogs often just slide right in!"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 81], "size": 5, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": []}], "text": "Host: I get that. But what about the toppings? They’re basically the same, right?"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 101], "size": 5, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": []}], "text": "Guest: That’s debatable! Some hot dogs have ketchup and mustard; others might just be spicy sausages!"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 57], "size": 5, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": []}], "text": "Host: Alright, let’s wrap this up. What’s the final call?"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 110], "size": 5, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": []}], "text": "Guest: Well, it depends on your definition of a sandwich! But in my book, nope—it’s definitely not a sandwich!"}
